blocks.text:
Fly to Campo Grande. On arrival, transfer to the Pantanal.

Located in the heart of South America, the Pantanal is one of Brazil’s largest natural areas. Wetlands, dense vegetation, lakes and rivers shape its landscape and provide a habitat for many birds and animals.

Travellers stay in lodges. During your stay, activities may include horseback rides across plains, through undergrowth and shallow water, as well as guided walks along the Pantanal’s nature trails.

Guides choose the activities according to the weather, season and wildlife-viewing conditions. Excursions start early in the morning, when the chances of seeing wildlife are higher.

Excursions and meals are included during your stay in the Pantanal.
